ProCuity ZMX

Smart, connected ICU hospital bed system

Designed to enhance safety and outcomes in the ICU while delivering a better experience for care teams.

text.text:
Help prevent pressure injuries in the ICU

Preventing pressure injuries for your most critical patients is one of your top priorities. It’s ours, too. That’s why we designed ProCuity ZMX to integrate with our premium support surface, Isolibrium PE. Our safest, most innovative and versatile hospital bed system helps to reduce pressure injuries and simplify nurse workflows to enable safer care and better outcomes in the ICU.

$26.8 billion

The annual treatment costs for pressure injuries in the U.S.1

2.5 million

People in the U.S. develop pressure injuries each year.1

60,000

The number of U.S. deaths recorded annually due to presure injuries.1

text_copy_copy.text: Powered support surface, smart prompts and hospital bed extender

text.text:
• The Isolibrium PE hospital mattress provides powered support for turning patients, pressure redistribution, lateral rotation and more.
  • Smart prompts on the footboard remind the nurse to save a patient’s weight or to inflate the surface after CPR.
  • ProCuity ZMX’s integrated bed extender can stretch 12 inches to maintain a therapeutic surface for taller patients’ heels.

text_copy.text:
Enabling safety and efficiency

Whether it’s reducing the strain of transport or easing the burden of remembering to perform workflow tasks that support fall prevention protocols, ProCuity is loaded with features that enhance efficiency and safety for patients and staff.

standaloneimage_copy_1734962492.alt: Stryker's Zoom Motorized Drive on the ProCuity ZMX ICU bed lets you move patients safely with less caregiver strain

text.text:
Move with Zoom

Easy and intuitive to use, Zoom Motorized Drive allows you to move patients safely and with less staff, while helping to reduce caregiver back strain.

  • Zoom senses your hand and automatically deploys or retracts the wheel.
  • Go forward or reverse, with hand-adjustable speed control.
  • Zero-degree turn helps ease the strain of navigating tight turns in narrow hallways.
  • Tuck the collapsible handle away when it’s not needed.

standaloneimage_5499.alt: Procuity ZMX ICU bed digital touch screen at the foot of the hospital bed

text_copy.text:
Intuitive, durable 8-inch touch screen

With our intuitive, easy-access touch screen at the foot of the hospital bed, you’re never more than one screen away from the home screen and one touch away from the features you use most, including controls for the Isolibrium PE powered support surface. Help reduce errors with smart prompts – helpful reminders to save the patient’s weight, inflate the surface after CPR and more. The durable touchscreen is tested for resistance to impact and cleaning agents.

Support for early mobility in the ICU

ProCuity ZMX and the Isolibrium PE support surface work together to support early mobility while helping to ease physical strain for the care team.

standaloneimage_9236.alt: Procuity ZMX ICU bed frame supports early mobility

text.text:
Stand-assist, low height, adjustable siderails and continuous lateral rotation therapy

ProCuity’s frame and support surfaces work together to support early mobility while helping to ease physical strain for the care team.

  • Stand-assist button helps put the patient in an optimal position to get up.
  • 14-inch low height allows firm footing.
  • Stand-assist button and intermediate three-position siderails help the patient get into and out of the bed safely while also supporting caregiver safety.
  • The powered Isolibrium support surface provides continuous lateral rotation therapy up to 40 degrees* to assist with early mobility and pulmonary rehabilitation.

 

* Depending on patient weight, position and morphology

text_copy.text:
Connect the bed to connect the nurse

When patients need constant monitoring and intervention, nurses need constant connection. ProCuity – the only truly wireless hospital bed on the market – delivers. Connected ProCuity shares bed and surface data with your electronic health record, nurse call, clinical communication system and more.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Delivering the information nurses need 

  • Nurses can receive bed data and priority notifications through their mobile device when they can’t be at the bedside.†
  • With Secure Connect, ProCuity automatically connects to your facility’s nurse call system cable-free to transmit nurse call requests, bed exit alarms and more, with 99.99% reliability.††
  • Our Vision clinical dashboard gives nurses and staff remote visibility to safe bed protocol compliance.

text.text:
Isolibrium PE – helping to drive better outcomes in the ICU

Isolibrium PE is a powered hospital mattress designed to assist in the prevention and treatment of all pressure injuries by providing powered support for turning patients, pressure redistribution, lateral rotation and more. 

Learn more

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Isolibrium hospital mattress helps maximize pressure redistribution through unique air pod technology.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Patient-specific immersion

Unique air pod and zoned sensor technologies help maximize pressure redistribution by adjusting based on the patient’s weight range and changes in position.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Isolibrium's hospital mattress air channeling technology delivers low-airloss toward the patients' most vulnerable areas for skin breakdown without internal obstruction.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Enhanced microclimate

Our air channeling technology delivers unobstructed low-air loss toward areas where the patient is most vulnerable to skin breakdown.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: HeelGel technology helps reduce the potential of a pressure injury on the heel while in n ICU hospital bed

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
HeelGel technology

HeelGel is designed to buckle when heel pressure is applied and move that pressure to the calf, helping to reduce the potential of a pressure injury.

text.text:
Case study: Quality improvement using support surfaces2

Discover how a medical center achieved a 91.7% decrease in hospital acquired pressure injuries using state-of-the-art ICU bed technology – and saved an estimated $660,000 to $5,006,100.2***

standaloneimage.description: Total number of HAPIs reported in the ICU before and after intervention.
standaloneimage.alt: Chart showing total number of HAPIs reported in the ICU before and after intervention.

text.text:
This study was performed to monitor the occurrence of pressure injuries in patients receiving treatment in the adult cardiovascular ICU (CVICU) and adult intensive care unit (ICU).

Conclusion:

  • Preventive measures administered and conducted by hospital personnel can successfully limit the number of HAPIs only to a certain degree.
  • When combined with these efforts, state-of-the-art patient bed technology can significantly decrease HAPI occurrence, leading to enhanced patient care and decreased hospital cost.

Read the full case study

Featuring head of bed accessibility for intubation, a large 8-inch touchscreen for easier workflow, Zoom Motorized Drive, which allows caregivers to move critical patients with ease, and ProCuity ZMX's seamless integration with our most advanced mattress to date, Isolibrium, to help prevent pressure injuries. These features help make ProCuity ZMX a true ICU bed.

text_295406748_copy_.text:
50% rental reduction guarantee

Stryker’s Isolibrium Support Surface Financial Guarantee is designed to reduce non-capital support surface costs for the hospital by 50% in the first year. If this goal is not achieved, Stryker will reimburse the hospital up to the difference between the guaranteed savings amount and the actual savings (reimbursement amount not to exceed the purchase price for Isolibrium).*

30% HAPI guarantee

Stryker’s HAPI Financial Guarantee: Stryker guarantees participating facilities a 30% reduction of HAPIs (Stages 3, 4, unstageable, DTI) for patients using the Stryker Isolibrium/Isolibrium PE, IsoTour, IsoFlex LAL, Stryker IsoAir or Stryker Isolibrium Support Surface, for a guaranteed period.**
